The AUP recognises customer AI and preserves its prohibited-use boundaries. AUP compliance monitoring and compelled disclosure do not authorise ordinary support or training. AUP changes and SLA changes use different amendment mechanisms. Neither creates a copilot launch-notice requirement. Infrastructure maintenance has separate scope and notice terms.
